name: Gypsy Encampment
desc1: A large clearing has been made here in the grass by trampling down the
desc2: stalks until they sprang up no more. Sitting at the edge of the
desc3: clearing is a large covered wooden wagon, painted with bright colours
desc4: and hung with all sorts of wares. A bonfire burns brightly in the
desc5: centre, and tethered to a nearby log are two shaggy horses.
